lastCompletedStory.title: Extend the allowlist hook + settings matcher to deny worker-actor Write to prd.json

nextStoryContext: US-006 was the last story of CAM-63 (the ADR 0035 sole-writer epic: US-003 made the supervisor the sole writer in finalizeStory, US-005 removed the flip-instruction from the implementer prompts, US-006 mechanically enforces it at the hook layer). settings.json (both .claude/ and templates/.claude/ copies) now carries a SECOND PreToolUse matcher entry ("Write|Edit|MultiEdit") alongside the existing "Task|Agent" one, both routed to the same orch-agent-allowlist.sh script. The script now branches on .tool_name FIRST: for Write/Edit/MultiEdit it denies only when CAM_WORKER=1 (worker-actor marker, US-002) is set AND tool_input.file_path suffix-matches scripts/cam/prd.json; otherwise (including the planner, which runs under CAM_SESSION without CAM_WORKER) it allows. The pre-existing Task/Agent subagent-type capability policy is untouched, just relocated after the new tool_name case block. All 6 new test cases live in test/orch-agent-allowlist.test.ts (worker+prd.json deny x3 tool names, worker+non-prd allow, planner/no-marker+prd.json allow, unscoped+worker allow). Ran embed-vendor after editing templates/ (embed source of truth); embed-vendor:check, typecheck, bun test (4456 pass), and bun run check:all are all green. This closes out CAM-63's PRD -- check scripts/cam/prd.json for any remaining passes:false stories before assuming the whole PRD is done; if none remain (besides operator-tagged ones), the next dispatch should be a review cycle, not another implement story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed matcher exact-match pipe syntax ("Edit|Write"), the hookSpecificOutput/hookEventName/permissionDecision/permissionDecisionReason deny JSON shape, and that tool_name + tool_input.file_path are the correct payload fields for Write/Edit/MultiEdit calls -- implementation matches current docs exactly, no corrections needed.
